response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced generalist engineer (15+ years) with strong full-stack, distributed systems, and developer-tooling credentials, plus recent exposure to MCP code generators and agentic workflow infrastructure at re:cinq. However, the role requires 8+ years building production-grade AI/GenAI solutions, and the resume shows roughly one year of adjacent AI-infrastructure work with no evidence of RAG architectures, vector databases, data pipelines for unstructured data, LLM evaluation/observability, or multi-agent frameworks. Python is also absent from the skills list, and cloud experience is limited to AWS CDK on one product team. Strong engineering fundamentals and mentoring/teaching track record make him a plausible fit for a general staff engineering role, but not for a Staff Forward Deployed GenAI specialist position as written.
strengths: 15+ years shipping production software across web, mobile, embedded, and high-throughput microservices; strong TypeScript/Node.js depth
Hands-on MCP code generators and agentic workflow tooling at re:cinq — directly relevant emerging tech
Proven mentoring, workshop delivery, and open-source leadership (GISCollective, Trial, Fluent-Asserts) indicating technical-leadership capability
concerns: Only ~1 year of AI-adjacent work versus the required 8+ years of production AI solutions
No demonstrated RAG, vector database, LLM evaluation/optimization, or multi-agent framework experience; Python not listed among skills
Limited cloud-platform breadth (AWS CDK only) and no evidence of customer-facing discovery or forward-deployed consulting engagements

key_factors.factor: Missing RAG, vector DB, and multi-agent expertise
Senior/staff engineering breadth and MCP exposure
